player_prompt.intro:
Marḥba s Lights Out! Ɣur-k a tɣimit {size}x{size} n tifawt.
Tazzla-k a d-tɣellem akk tifawt OFF (ttbanent s '.').
Mellmi tɣelliḍ tafawt, ad tettɣellem d tifawt i yqnnaten (s ufella/s wadda/s tama tazelmaḍt/s tama tayemmatt).
Tikti [row col] akken ad tɣelliḍ tafawt (0-indexed, ihi tazmilt tazdawt tga 0-{max_index}).
Ɣur-k ar {max_turns} n imyaten akken ad tettfaṣem tazzla.
Asalay: 'O' = tafawt immaqqoren, '.' = tafawt ittɣellemn

invalid_move.out_of_range: Izirigiyen iratt ad gan gar 0 d {max_index}. Tekkiḍ [{row},{col}].
